description: Get a cryptographic receipt for one AI inference. Returns a signed Ed25519 attestation, sha256 content hash, and Merkle chain-anchor status for {prompt, response, model_id}. The notary does NOT store your prompt or response — only the hash is retained. Costs $0.001 USDC via x402 (requires WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY for Base or SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY for Solana).

client_timestamp.description: Optional ISO-8601 time the inference ran. Included in the content hash if provided.

prompt.description: The exact prompt/input that was sent to the model

response.description: The exact model output you want a receipt for

name: notarize_inference
